text:
maria: quick postmortem follow-up on yesterday's missing-spans + bad-agg incident. want to lock owners, timelines, and recurring pattern checks. who can own the full remediation?
aj: I can take primary ownership for the aggregation fix. I'll scope the query & index changes. target: 2 weeks (2025-03-10) for PR + canary.
sanjay: I'll own the ETL lag/backfill plan. quick mitigation: run backfill job over last 6 hrs to fix immediate data gaps. ETA for backfill today EOD.
leah: I'll update the observability runbook and add a unit test for span dedup/merge logic. also want a post-deploy regression test for aggregation. can we add that to the repo?
maria: thanks. action summary: aj -> agg fix (2025-03-10), sanjay -> ETL backfill + fix (2025-02-28), leah -> runbook + tests (2025-02-25). i'll track weekly check-ins.
incident-bot: [AUTO] Incident INC-2456 severity P2 closed. Runbook link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/inc-2456.
aj: quick notes on scope: root cause seems to be an off-by-one in the rollup window + a stale mapping causing group keys to drop. plan: patch rollup window calc + reindex affected partitions (shard 3-5).
sanjay: for ETL lag, we're seeing burst of out-of-order messages from kafka topic observability.v1. I'm adding stricter ordering checks and a tombstone filter. scheduling reprocess job: `./scripts/reprocess --topic observability.v1 --from 2025-02-20T00:00Z`
leah: tests I'll add: 1) synthetic span stream with intentional out-of-order delivery 2) aggregation race condition harness 3) CI gate that runs a 5-min smoke on push.
maria: can we add ticket IDs to each action so customer-success can track?
aj: created AGG-1123 for aggregation fix and PR workflow. link: https://redwood.example/tickets/AGG-1123. assigned to aj.
sanjay: created ETL-884 for reprocessing and backlog audit. assigned to sanjay, due 2025-02-28.
leah: created DOC-45 for runbook updates and TEST-302 for regression tests.
maria: recurring pattern note: this is the third span/aggregation incident in the last 90 days. we should add a recurring incident retro and a deeper audit of our batching heuristics. propose a 1-day war room + 2-week tech spike to harden KV cache and rollup logic.
aj: +1 to spike. will draft scope tomorrow.
sanjay: recommend adding a Prometheus alert for 'rollup-coverage-drop > 5% for 10m' and an automated backfill trigger that runs a single-partition reprocess when coverage dips.
leah: can product or CS confirm acceptable data staleness SLA for these customers? we'll need that for prioritization.
maria: @product-ops can you chime in? (cc @customer-success)
product-ops: (not in thread participants, reply expected separately)
maria: ok, next steps: owners start tickets, set due dates, add brief weekly status in this thread every Friday. i'll run the first check-in next Fri 2025-02-21. please ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:
aj: will post initial PR plan by tomorrow. :eyes:
sanjay: backfill job kicked off, monitoring logs now. I'll post status once complete.
leah: started runbook edits, will open PR today.
maria: thanks all. recording action list in AGG-1123/ETL-884/DOC-45. closing this thread for now, will reopen on next check-in.
